software.name: MXO Title Kit
software.author: MERAJXO
software.tagline: 36 drag-and-drop neon titles for After Effects.
software.description: A template pack + extension with 36 editable neon/glow title scenes. Every scene is expression-driven: change one slider and the whole animation retimes itself.

setup.title: Install the extension
setup.description: Copy the MXO Title Kit folder into the CEP extensions directory and restart After Effects.

setup.title: Open the panel
setup.description: Window → Extensions → MXO Title Kit. Double-click any scene to import it into your project.

setup.title: Enable player debugging
setup.description: Only needed if the panel opens as a blank window.

software.name: Lo-Fi Grain Pack
software.author: MERAJXO
software.description: Twelve grain/halation presets tuned for social-media compression. Works in After Effects and Premiere (via .mogrt).

setup.title: Import the presets
setup.description: Drop the .ffx files into your user presets folder, or drag them straight into a comp.

setup.title: Apply & tune
setup.description: Effects → User Presets → Lo-Fi Grain. Each look exposes intensity + scale sliders.
